claim: The static import table imports winhttp.dll and wininet.dll (HTTP) and steam_api64.dll but no ws2_32.dll. Any socket networking is not visible in static imports.
evidence: imports list: wininet 8 functions, winhttp 1, steam_api64 1; ws2_32 absent.
game_build_compatibility: Measured on exe SHA-256 ED0D95CABB033CD66AAA99D699374881846C3CB03EC345F1123D82D45E0BDAEF (FileVersion 1.0.8874.0, Steam buildid 3095001)
verification_method: Read-only local inspection with tools/environment/discover_game.py and pe_inventory.py; re-run scripts/inventory.ps1 to reproduce.
limitations: The small import table (F-ENV-004) means further APIs may be resolved at runtime; absence from static imports proves nothing about runtime use.
